hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched from off to on at about 15:30. With it on, the account page's spend summary code hits a ZeroDivisionError at spend_summary.py:47, and the error rate rose from about 1% to about 33%. No deployment, config change or rollout split is recorded, and the replicas did not move.

supporting_evidence.claim: ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:47
monthly-spend-feature=on - 200 evaluations (previously off in every minute)
